verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's Marketing API documents an account export endpoint ('Generate a new account export or download a finished account export') that would allow bulk data export [mailchimp-docs-16], but independent community reports describe accounts being deleted or banned with contacts and mailing lists lost entirely, with support denying data existed until pressured, directly undercutting the promise of being able to cleanly export data and leave [mailchimp-comm-1][mailchimp-comm-2]. Missing for 10: clear documentation of the export's format (CSV/JSON/open standard), and no evidence the export mechanism reliably works before account termination or ban events reported by users.
